Unit 6 — Jumping

Platforming, from the inside: a physics flick, an honest ground check, and the three mercy timers that make controls feel tight. The unit's studio day builds the Gauntlet — the first level you design for strangers.

Concepts this unit owns

Feel as engineering: every "tight" jump is three tunable numbers with names. Also the raycast — asking physics a question per frame — and the counter-vs-bool data decision. CED: AAP-3, DAT-1 (the tuning data), CRD-1.
